header: An overall score, then one row per criterion
lead: Each row has five segments, so type 4.5, not 90 %. The overall score is typed, not averaged from the rows; say in the note how it was worked out.
note: Example: a usability test with twelve library members, September 2026. The overall score is the testers’ own rating of the whole site, not the mean of the rows.

metrics.title: Finding the opening hours
metrics.text: All twelve testers found them in under ten seconds.

metrics.title: Renewing a loan
metrics.text: Two testers looked for the button under ‘Account’ first.

metrics.title: Booking an event
metrics.text: The date picker was the slowest step.

metrics.title: Searching the catalogue
metrics.text: A typo returned no results; a fix is planned.
